summary: Plan for task 509 written as a transplant from the three compiled probes, not a derivation. 6 phases, 5.25h, 5 dependency waves. Independent grep re-verification of every anchor confirmed the research's own citations but found three defects in its call-site inventory: (1) build-breaking -- StrongCompleteness.lean:1047-1049 carry live '#print axioms' directives on three of the four theorems being deleted, so the research's claim of no consumers outside Compactness.lean is wrong and deletion without rewriting that block is a hard elaboration error; (2) the prose surface naming the deleted theorems is 25 in-tree .lean docstring sites plus 8 documentation sites, not the 2 the research listed; (3) the stale SetConsequence.lean:NNN citation list spans architecture.md:823-829 (seven rows), not :824-826. Plan sequences redefinition (Phase 3) BEFORE theorem collapse (Phase 4) so the Base model-existence bridge applies directly with no throwaway transport theorem. Phase 3 is marked atomic-batch because the binder-shape change and its six call-site repairs cannot be split without a red tree. Tests/ confirmed to have zero consumers -- no test edits in this task, unlike 508's 118.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 5.25-hour plan collapsing the compactness/strong-completeness layer onto a FrameClass-indexed family by transplanting pre-compiled probe text.

notes: Phase 0 of the plan carries three standing warnings: probe_509b_negative_control.lean is ANNOTATED EXPECTED-TO-FAIL and must not be repaired; lake-build-guard.sh build --timeout 1800 -- with an empty target list runs bare lake and exits 0 without building; the two pre-existing gate failures (check-module-invariants.sh C6, readme-lint.sh check 1) are pre-recorded reasoned exclusions while a C14/C15 regression would be this task's defect.
Eight of the ten per-class statements are rfl-recoveries, courtesy of task 507's valid := ValidIn .Base. The plan explicitly forbids proof work where rfl suffices.

The Dedekind handoff block is written into Phase 6 verbatim for the summary: Part 1 is four abbrevs plus two one-line theorems, all already compiled in probe_509.lean Part E; Part 2 stays hard because .Dedekind is IsDense AND IsComplete, an And with no successor structure for Order.succ^[n] to act on.
